summary_en: This study tests whether cladribine, low dose cytarabine, venetoclax, and azacitidine together can help control higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts and/or higher-risk chronic myelomonocytic leukemia. Participants receive cladribine, cytarabine, and venetoclax for 2 cycles, then azacitidine and venetoclax for 2 cycles, repeating this pattern for up to a total of 18 (the unit is not fully stated in the record). The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa si la combinación de cladribina, citarabina a dosis bajas, venetoclax y azacitidina puede ayudar a controlar el síndrome mielodisplásico de mayor riesgo con exceso de blastos y/o la leucemia mielomonocítica crónica de mayor riesgo. Los participantes reciben cladribina, citarabina y venetoclax durante 2 ciclos, y luego azacitidina y venetoclax durante 2 ciclos, repitiendo este patrón hasta un total de 18 (la unidad no está completamente indicada en el registro). El resultado principal no se indica; este es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with higher-risk MDS or CMML.
Patients who did not respond to, or relapsed after, certain azacitidine-type drugs, or who have not received these drugs before (cohorts vary).
Daily activity level (performance status) of 2 or lower.
Able to sign an informed consent document.
not_for: Uncontrolled infection that does not respond to antibiotics.
Heart failure of NYHA class III or IV, or ejection fraction below 50%.
Heart attack within the last 6 months, or unstable or uncontrolled angina.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or those with reproductive potential unwilling to use required contraception.
Receiving another investigational drug, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or immunotherapy.
